policy: Entries must use a vendor-authoritative HTTPS source and a vendor-published SHA-256 value. Do not stage a product until its version, source URL, checksum, support channel, and approval status are verified.

packages.installationVerification: Expected executable version in Program Files and matching HKLM uninstall registration; process launch is not success.
packages.stagingBlocker: Approve the Chrome Enterprise x64 MSI vendor version, unique Gallery version, immutable authorized source, MSI hash/signer, ZIP hash, reviewed commands, rollback and pilot scope. Package the MSI, Install-ChromeEnterpriseMsi.ps1, and a reviewed pinned launch script together; do not reuse the failed EXE package.
